_comment: Actor Factory convention, not read by Apify. With managedByPublisher on, the Publisher lowers the Actor's price in Apify to these values after each deploy (never raises it: increases are done in Apify Console). Results are charged with Apify's synthetic per-item event, so keep no other per-result event.
